text:
maria: Seeing elevated GPU evictions in bay1 (us-west1) since 03:12 UTC. Pool util ~98% and multiple pods were OOMKilled.
ops-bot: Incident detected — gpu-pool-pressure bay1. Autoscaler triggered. Recommended action: traffic shift to nearby pool (us-west2) or preempt batch jobs.
jamal: Oncall here. I'm initiating a phased traffic shift to us-west2 now, non-critical routes first. Will monitor error rates.
kevin: FYI provisioning backlog in us-west2; cold start/image bake is causing ~20–30m node readiness. We can preempt spot batch jobs to reclaim ~12 GPUs in 7–10m.
linda: Support: Acme, Foodly, NovaPay reporting increased latencies and 429s. Escalations opened. We need a customer-facing status note and ETA.
jamal: Draft status blurb I'm about to post: "We are experiencing elevated load in Bay1 (us-west1) that is causing slower responses for some customers. Traffic is being shifted to alternate pools and we expect services to stabilize within 40–50 minutes. We will provide updates every 15 minutes." Any edits?
kevin: Add a short line about potential degraded throughput and cross-region egress impacting costs for some requests.
maria: Working with scheduler to throttle long-running batch jobs and preempt non-critical tasks — should free ~12 GPUs in 7–10m. Will update once freed.
linda: If we can free 12 GPUs that reduces risk to enterprise customers. Finance has pre-approved goodwill credits up to $Xk for impacted customers — looping in finance-bot.
finance-bot: Noted. Please attach affected org IDs and estimated token counts for review after incident.
ops-bot: Routing action executed at 03:28 UTC — shifting ~35% of non-SLA traffic to us-west2. Rollback criteria: error rate >5% or latency increase >1s over baseline.
jamal: Posted statuspage update and pinned it to #incidents. Command used:
```
curl -X POST https://status.redwood.ai/api/v1/messages -d '{"lo": "bay1 capacity issue", "body": "..."}'
```
kevin: Provisioner now shows 8 new nodes queued; ETA ~23m due to image bake. If we want faster, we can preempt smaller VMs but that will risk evictions elsewhere.
maria: Partial relief observed — eviction rate down, but 99th pct latency still elevated. Keeping throttles and traffic shift in place. Monitoring dashboard: http://grafana/redwood/boards/GPUPool
linda: Support outreach messages queued to affected orgs. I'll include the statuspage link and a short FAQ. Legal asks us to avoid admitting SLA breaches until postmortem.
jamal: Agreed. If capacity is not back to acceptable levels in 30m we'll escalate to dedicated-capacity owners and consider emergency preempt policies.
maria: I'll post another update at 03:45 UTC or sooner if things change. :thumbsup:
